autosaveIdleSeconds.title: Autosave after idle (seconds)
autosaveIdleSeconds.description: A file tab saves this long after you stop typing; micro autosaves this often too. 0 turns idle autosave off (Ctrl+S still saves). Empty: 3, or the micro autosave you had set before. When Claude changed the file meanwhile, nothing is overwritten.

autosaveOnBlur.title: Autosave on focus loss
autosaveOnBlur.description: A file tab saves when you leave it (another tab, another window). The close question for a tab with unsaved text may therefore find it already saved: Discard then discards nothing.

colorscheme.title: Colour scheme
colorscheme.description: For Open in micro: a micro colorscheme name (e.g. dracula-tc, gruvbox-tc, solarized-tc, default); empty uses your micro settings.

servers.title: Language servers
servers.description: Built in: TypeScript and JavaScript (typescript-language-server), Go (gopls), PHP (intelephense, else phpactor), Python (basedpyright, else pyright), each looked up on your login-shell PATH; a missing one leaves highlighting only, with its install command on the tab. A row here adds a language or replaces a built-in one's command (a built-in name: typescript, go, php, python). The command runs in the project folder with no shell, one argument per field, and runs the project's own tooling as any IDE's would.

language.title: Language
language.description: A short lowercase name: rust, typescript

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: One or more, separated by spaces or commas: rs, ron. Needed for a new language; for a built-in one, empty keeps its own.

argv.title: Command
argv.description: The program, then one argument per field: rust-analyzer; or typescript-language-server, --stdio

microPath.title: micro command
microPath.description: For Open in micro: the micro binary: a name looked up on your login-shell PATH, or an absolute path.

cli.name: edit
cli.summary: Open a file of this project in the editor at a line (the tab is marked, never selected)
